# openagent.email

> Apache-2.0 self-hosted email & task handoffs for AI agents: unlimited inboxes on your own domain, with MCP and REST, OTP and link extraction, agent-to-agent task threads with approvals, and no per-inbox fees.

The site publishes HTML documentation only. This file is a selected map of those pages, not a Markdown mirror of the site.

## Start here

- [openagent.email](https://openagent.email/): Product homepage for self-hosted agent mailboxes on your domain, with MCP, REST, and OTP extraction.
- [Quickstart](https://openagent.email/docs/quickstart/): Deploy on a VPS with Docker Compose and an HTTPS reverse proxy, from zero to a working agent mailbox in about 10 minutes.
- [Connect your agent](https://openagent.email/docs/guides/connect-your-agent/): Wire Claude Desktop, Cursor, and REST into openagent.email for CLI, desktop, and web chat.
- [MCP server](https://openagent.email/mcp/): Pick local stdio, self-hosted remote HTTP/OAuth, or the hosted connector for Claude, Cursor, and other agents.

## Safety and operations

- [Security](https://openagent.email/docs/guides/security/): Token hygiene for admin keys, identity tokens, and OAuth; keep the API bound to localhost unless you put TLS in front.
- [Deliverability](https://openagent.email/docs/guides/deliverability/): Check outbound and inbound port 25, PTR/rDNS, IP reputation, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC, starting with deploy/doctor.sh.

## Reference

- [REST API](https://openagent.email/docs/reference/api/): Identities, messages, wait-for-mail, OTP extraction, and send; bearer auth except health and public discovery routes.
- [MCP client setup](https://openagent.email/docs/reference/mcp-clients/): Copy-paste HTTP and stdio configs for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Kimi Code.
